_comment: Committed CI replay-gate floors (D6). Initially set so the GENERATED seed fixtures pass (the seeds are program templates lifted from examples/*_program.json, retargeted by question text, so every in-scope seed grounds to its expected answer -> T2/T4 = 1.0). After the first live capture the runbook recalibrates these ~5pp under the measured real rates (the same calibration move #36 used for the coverage floor). Floors are a one-line diff to ratchet.
